conclusions: All four thread/MKLDNN arms are identical on M1; unavailable MKLDNN contributes duplicated controls, not backend coverage.

Empty first differs at layer_0.q, with287 differing stages. All six non-empty cases first differ at layer_0.rope_cos by5.960464477539063e-8; pair has335 differing stages and the other five have336. Linux first differs at layer_0.q with287 stages in every case.
Every selected loaded parameter hash and every same-input projection input hash matches Linux; original sources, input arrays and weight bits were retained.

No full forward or same-input projection recovers the frozen target bit-for-bit. F64 diagnostics do not recover all frozen values. F16-weight diagnostics compare rounded weights against the original module; they are not a replacement full-model reference.

Worst raw CLS max_abs is6.520748138427734e-5; normalized CLS max_abs is6.413320079445839e-7. These absolute errors are below0.002, but do not establish strict replay, native parity or task accuracy. The diagnostic does not report cosine.

This independently measures platform-sensitive results, including RoPE tables, without isolating a root cause. Existing native183 F32/1294 F16 failures and strict replay requirements remain; no thresholds or reference arrays changed.

The first resource-stopped attempt is retained separately. Its numeric256MiB cutoff was an agent-selected conservative policy, not a threshold mandated by the handover. The authorized retry used sustained-pressure monitoring and recorded no new system swapouts.
